faqs.question: How long does a typical website build take?
faqs.answer: A standard 5-page corporate site takes about 2 weeks from kickoff to launch. Larger projects with custom features may take 4–6 weeks. We'll give you a precise timeline after the initial consultation.

faqs.question: Do you offer post-launch maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every build includes 3 months of free post-launch support (bug fixes, content updates, performance monitoring). After that, ongoing maintenance retainers start at ¥19,800/month.

faqs.question: Can I update the site myself after launch?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. All our sites include a CMS (PayloadCMS) so you can edit text, images, blog posts, and pricing without touching code. We provide a video walkthrough and written guide.

faqs.question: Do you do e-commerce sites?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build Shopify storefronts and custom Next.js + Stripe e-commerce solutions. Payment integration includes credit cards, Konbini, and PayPay for the Japan market.

faqs.question: What if I already have a site? Can you redesign it?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can redesign your existing site while preserving your SEO equity (URLs, metadata, content). We handle the migration so there's zero downtime.

faqs.question: What's the difference between SEO and MEO?
faqs.answer: SEO focuses on ranking in Google's web search results. MEO (Map Engine Optimization) focuses on ranking in Google Maps and the local 3-pack. For businesses with physical locations, MEO often delivers faster, higher-intent traffic.

faqs.question: How long until I see results from MEO?
faqs.answer: Most clients see measurable improvements within 1–3 months. Rankings improve gradually as we optimize your profile, build reviews, and post regularly. We provide monthly rank-tracking reports.

faqs.question: Do I need to respond to every review?
faqs.answer: We handle review monitoring and response templates. Responding to reviews — especially negative ones — is one of the highest-impact MEO activities. We'll draft responses and keep your profile active.

faqs.question: Can you help if I have multiple locations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Pro plan covers multiple locations. We manage each Google Business Profile separately with location-specific optimization, posting calendars, and review strategies.

faqs.question: What is GEO and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) optimizes your content to be cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. As more users switch to AI search, appearing in AI-generated answers is becoming as important as traditional Google rankings.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee #1 rankings?
faqs.answer: No ethical SEO provider can guarantee specific rankings — Google's algorithm changes constantly. What we guarantee: data-driven strategy, transparent monthly reporting, and continuous improvement. Our MEO service includes a results-based refund window.

faqs.question: How is Paradigm's SEO different from other agencies?
faqs.answer: We combine traditional SEO with GEO (AI-search optimization). Most agencies still only optimize for Google. We prepare your content for ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity too — future-proofing your search presence.

faqs.question: What's included in the monthly SEO retainer?
faqs.answer: Monthly keyword research, 2–8 articles (depending on plan), technical SEO audits, structured data implementation, backlink monitoring, GEO optimization, and a detailed monthly report with rankings, traffic, and conversion data.

faqs.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use AI tools?
faqs.answer: No. We handle the entire setup and provide training in plain language. You'll get written guides and a walkthrough video. Our support team is available for questions anytime.

faqs.question: What AI tools do you work with?
faqs.answer: We integrate DeepSeek V4, ChatGPT, Gemini, Dify (AI workflow builder), and n8n (automation). The specific stack depends on your use case and budget. We recommend the best tools during the initial consultation.

faqs.question: Can AI integrate with our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. We connect AI to Google Workspace, Slack, CRMs, databases, and custom APIs. Most integrations take 1–2 weeks depending on complexity.

faqs.question: Is my business data safe with AI?
faqs.answer: We use enterprise-grade API endpoints with encryption in transit and at rest. Your data is never used to train public AI models. For highly sensitive data, we can deploy on-premise or private cloud instances.

faqs.question: What's the ROI of AI integration?
faqs.answer: Most clients see ROI within 2–4 months. A chatbot handling 200 inquiries/month saves ~40 hours of staff time — roughly ¥120,000/month in labor costs. Automation of reporting and data entry typically saves 10–20 hours/week.

faq.heading: Questions foreign founders ask
faq.q1: Do I need a Japanese legal entity to start?
faq.a1: Not to begin. We can launch your localized presence and test the market first; entity setup is part of the Enterprise tier or a later step once demand is proven.
faq.q2: How do payments work without a Japanese bank?
faq.a2: We set up Japan-friendly payment rails (Konbini, PayPay, cards) through providers that work for foreign sellers, and advise on settlement.
faq.q3: How long until I'm live in Japan?
faq.a3: A localized launch typically takes 30–90 days depending on tier and scope. The Market Fit Report gives you a precise timeline up front.
faq.q4: Do I need to speak or write Japanese?
faq.a4: No. Everything with you is in English. All Japanese-facing work — site, support, compliance — is handled on our side.
faq.a5: Three fixed-scope tiers (Essential / Growth / Enterprise). Start with the $1,500 Market Fit Report, which is credited to your first month.
faq.q6: Can't I just use Google Translate or DeepL for my site?
faq.a6: Machine translation handles words, not trust. Japanese consumers are among the most discerning online — 78% say they won't purchase from a machine-translated site. Legal disclaimers, payment flows, and culturally appropriate UX can't be auto-translated. Our localization covers language, culture, compliance, and conversion — not just vocabulary.
faq.q7: How is Paradigm different from hiring my own Japanese team?
faq.a7: A single bilingual Tokyo hire costs $60–120K/year in salary alone, plus recruiting (3–6 months), office, and management overhead. That one person can't do web development, MEO, LINE setup, legal compliance, and AI support simultaneously. Paradigm gives you the entire cross-functional stack for a one-time engagement — and you start in weeks, not quarters.
faq.q8: What happens after the engagement ends? Will I be left on my own?
faq.a8: Every engagement includes a complete handover package (credentials, docs, playbooks) and a 90-day warranty on all deliverables. We also offer ongoing maintenance retainers for continuous optimization, content updates, and support. You'll never be left with a black box — and we stay available for questions well beyond the engagement.

comparison.heading: The difference between "translating" and actually entering Japan
comparison.sub: Most options leave you with a translated site that still doesn't convert. Paradigm is Japan operations — not just words.
comparison.item1Body: Google Translate can't handle cultural adaptation, legal disclaimers, trust signals, or SEO. Japanese consumers spot machine translation instantly — and 78% won't buy from a machine-translated site.
comparison.item2Body: Language barrier, opaque pricing, and waterfall processes built for domestic clients. You'll spend weeks in email translation hell before seeing a single deliverable.
comparison.item3Body: Translation ≠ localization ≠ market entry. You need payments, compliance, discovery, and support — not just words on a page.
